summary: Frontend-only iteration 17: verified freelancer wizard hydration, /profile pro card, and /employer real-pro leads merge for WorkHop. All 5 in-scope scenarios PASS. Backend endpoints (/api/freelancer/{fid}, /api/freelancer/{fid}/profile, /api/leads/preview) confirmed live. Wizard on /freelancer with localStorage workhop_freelancer_id='test-pro-lead1' hydrates: step1 shows 'Payment Verified · ₹99', step2 shows aadhaar-success, step3 prefills phone=9876501234, skill='Mehendi Artist', GRAPHICS & DESIGN chip active (bg #121212 black), all 9 profile-cat-* chips render, profile-location-btn present & tappable without crash. Phone validation: 5-digit triggers 'Phone must be exactly 10 digits', 10-digit hides error. /profile pro-profile-card prefilled, save with 9876500011 returns 'Saved · employers see +91 98765 00011 after unlock', 5-digit save returns 10-digit error. /employer: Asha Rao is lead-0 (name+skill visible upfront), phone row shows '+91 ••••• •••••' (blurred/locked), selecting GRAPHICS & DESIGN chip keeps Asha visible, seeded leads (Sneha, Rohan, etc.) still render, search 'logo' works.

react_native_issues.issue: React web console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/freelancer/index.tsx:498 — pointerEvents is set inside the style array (correct on native) but RN Web still logs. Non-blocking; consider gating with Platform.OS !== 'web' or move to a conditional style key.

React 19 console error: 'Accessing element.ref was removed in React 19. ref is now a regular prop.' Triggered on /employer page load. Non-blocking but should upgrade offending dep when patch is released.

action_items: No functional bugs to fix — all 5 in-scope scenarios pass end-to-end.
(Optional) Silence RN-Web 'pointerEvents' deprecation in freelancer/index.tsx StepBlock by dropping the style prop key on web only.
(Optional) Track upstream fix for 'element.ref' React 19 warning (likely @gorhom/bottom-sheet used on /employer).
critical_code_review_comments: freelancer/index.tsx: hydration effect correctly strips '+91' & non-digits before setPhone — matches backend's normalized storage.
profile.tsx savePro trims skill to null on empty, uses PUT /api/freelancer/{fid}/profile, and displays server-formatted phone from response — good UX.

employer/index.tsx: baseLeads filter accepts either skill match OR l.category === catFilter, which is what lets Asha Rao (category='Graphics & Design', skill='Mehendi Artist') pass the G&D chip filter.
